rationale: A 6-year-old girl admitted with a 1-month intermittent fever had a clinical admission diagnosis of typhoid fever, a positive Widal test, and isolation of Salmonella Paratyphi C in stool culture (E1 confirmatory microbiological isolation under Section 5.9 Typhoid/Paratyphoid Fever), alongside underlying autosomal recessive DADA2 deficiency identified on whole exome sequencing.
